actions.action: Bind approvals to exact paragraph revisions
actions.mechanism: Approval records identify source and translation revisions; publication rejects mismatches rather than inheriting approval through stable IDs.
actions.implementation: Store immutable paragraph revisions and approval tuples containing both IDs, both revision IDs, and reviewer identity. Validate against the publication manifest.
actions.check: Edit an approved source paragraph: publication must block its translation. An unchanged paragraph must retain its matching approval.
actions.risk: Checks must run atomically with publication to prevent revision races.

actions.mechanism: A compact change list directs attention; full before-and-after context remains available for judging accuracy.
actions.implementation: Group changes by stable paragraph ID. Display source differences, translation differences, approval status, and moves separately; link to full surrounding text.
actions.check: Test one move, one unchanged paragraph, and one substantive edit. Show the move without deletion/recreation, omit unchanged work, and flag the edit.
actions.risk: Small textual edits can change meaning; never classify accuracy automatically.

actions.action: Track context that can invalidate neighboring translations
actions.mechanism: Explicit dependencies capture meaning affected by headings, references, terminology, or paragraph placement, even when paragraph text stays unchanged.
actions.implementation: Let reviewers attach dependency IDs to approvals. On dependency edits or moves, require context reapproval for linked paragraphs without resetting unrelated approvals.
actions.check: Move a paragraph containing “above” beneath its referent: its context approval must expire. Moving an independent paragraph must preserve its content approval.
actions.risk: Missing dependencies can hide indirect effects; reviewers must inspect move context.

actions.action: Assign bounded review work across two volunteers
actions.mechanism: Exclusive assignments and revision-bound submissions prevent duplicate effort and stop obsolete review work from clearing newer changes.
actions.implementation: Maintain one pending item per affected paragraph per language. Assign either volunteer; reserve the other for uncertainty. Supersede pending items when revisions change.
actions.check: During an assigned review, edit its source again. Submitting the older review must leave the latest revision pending and unpublished.
actions.risk: Disputed paragraphs may remain blocked when both volunteers cannot agree.
